description: This file contains utility functions for reading files and collecting plugin source information based on directory structures and manifest files within a project.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads a file synchronously if it exists, returning its contents as a string, or null if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Collects information about bundled plugin sources within the project's 'extensions' directory, optionally filtering by presence of package.json.
